Biologi, kalastaja ja tutkimusmatkailija Jeremy Wade matkustaa ympäri maailmaa tutkimaan vesistöjä ja vesielämää. Tutkimuskohteisiin lukeutuvat muun muassa havainnot myyttisistä vesihirviöistä sekä alueet, joilta tietyt kalalajit ovat yhtäkkiä kadonneet. Iso-Britannia 2018

programme.title: Kalliovuorten eläinlääkäri
programme.desc: New World. Denverin intohimoisin ja periksiantamattomin eläinlääkäri on palannut, varvastossuissaan, pitkine hiuksineen ja tatuointeineen, Planned Pethood Plus -klinikalle. Denverin intohimoisin ja periksiantamattomin eläinlääkäri Jeff Young luotsaa Planned Pethood Plus -klinikkaansa suurella sydämellä. Dr. Jeff tiimeineen hoitaa kaikenkarvaisia eläimiä sekä klinikalla että siirtymällä tarpeen tullen paikan päälle syrjäisiin kohteisiin. Iso-Britannia 2015

programme.title: Akvaariomestarit
programme.desc: Alyssa's Charmed Tank. Näyttelijä, aktivisti ja yrittäjä Alyssa Milano tilaa akvaarion perheensä iloksi. Siitä tulee hienostunut allas, jossa on sisäänrakennettu viinipulloteline. Yhdysvallat 2017

programme.title: Phoenixin eläinpoliisit
programme.desc: A Voice for the Victim. Näe todiste epätavallisesta julmuudesta, kun eläinsuojaan tuodaan nuori kissa, jolla ei ole käpäliä. Dokumentaarinen sarja seuraa Phoenixissa toimivan Arizonan eläinsuojeluyhdistyksen (AHS) työtä kaltoinkohdeltujen eläinten hyväksi. Yhdysvallat 2009

programme.title: Phoenixin eläinpoliisit
programme.desc: Harness of Horror. Kenttätyön johtaja Stacie DaBolt ryhtyy tutkimaan asiaa, kun eläinsuojaan tuodaan koira, jolla on kivuliaat, syvälle hiertyneet valjaat ja erittäin takkuinen turkki. Dokumentaarinen sarja seuraa Phoenixissa toimivan Arizonan eläinsuojeluyhdistyksen (AHS) työtä kaltoinkohdeltujen eläinten hyväksi. Yhdysvallat 2009

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Gator Bait. Riistanvalvojat etsivät alligaattoria, joka on purrut miestä ja tämän 13-vuotiasta poikaa. Länsi-Teksasista löytynyt hylätty auto antaa aihetta uskoa, että teinityttö on kadonnut. Yhdysvallat 2015

programme.title: Eläinlääkärin elämää: Spesiaali
programme.desc: Yogi Goat. Kääpiövuohi saapuu vastaanotolle paiseen takia. Kameroita vieroksuva suojelukoira työllistää eläinlääkäri Lavignea. Eläinlääkäri Blue pitää sukupuolenpaljastamisjuhlat. Eläinlääkärit Blue, Ross ja Lavigne pyörittävät menestynyttä klinikkaansa Houstonissa. Heidän asiakaskuntansa koostuu kaikenkarvaisista lemmikeistä. Yhdysvallat 2019

programme.title: Koteja lemmikkiperheille
programme.desc: Best Builds. Antonio muistelee rakentajiensa kanssa isoimpia ja parhaimpia hankkeitaan. Kiitolliset omistajat kertovat miten paljon eläimet nauttivat uusista tiloistaan. Suunnittelija Antonio Ballatore rakastaa eläimiä. Hänen intohimonaan on yhdessä tiiminsä kanssa kunnostaa ränsistyneitä ja ahtaita koteja sekä niiden pihoja uuteen, eläin- ja ihmisystävällisempään kuosiin. Yhdysvallat 2018

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Kanani ja hänen kihlattunsa M2 valmistautuvat häihin. Jammall löytää hylätyn koiran, mutta tarvitsee Marian apua sen pelastamiseksi. Tia Torres kuntouttaa kaltoinkohdeltuja amerikanpitbullterriereitä ehdonalaisvankien avulla Villalobosin pelastuskeskuksessa. Tekemistä riittää, kun työntekijöiden pyrkimyksenä on myös muuttaa ihmisten asenteita kiisteltyä ja pelättyä koirarotua kohtaan. Yhdysvallat 2018

programme.title: Kissakuiskaaja
programme.desc: Psychic Disconnect. Maryam on eläinten selvänäkijä, mutta hän ei pysty kommunikoimaan vihaisen Lily-kissansa kanssa. Khloe löytää kokonaisen irtokissakolonian vanhempiensa talon takaa. Kissojen käyttäytymistä tutkiva Jackson Galaxy auttaa epätoivoisia kissanomistajia, joiden kodit ja ihmissuhteet ovat riekaleina näiden hurjien lemmikkien vuoksi. Yhdysvallat 2014

programme.title: Irwinin perheen eläintarha
programme.desc: Bindi and the Otters. Steve Irwinin perhe eli Terry, Bindi ja Robert jatkavat miehen jälkeensä jättämää perintöä ja työtä laajassa Australian eläintarhassa. Krokotiilimiehenä tunnetuksi tulleen Steve Irwinin perintö elää hänen leskessään Terrissä sekä lapsissaan Bindissä ja Robertissa. Intohimoisina luonnonsuojelijoina he pyörittävät aivan erityislaatuista Australian eläintarhaa, jossa toimii myös huipputason villieläinsairaala. Yhdysvallat 2018

programme.title: Kalliovuorten eläinlääkäri
programme.desc: Full Speed Ahead. Denverin työllistetyin eläinlääkäri palaa ruutuun. Amy tekee kokeellisen leikkauksen ruokahaluongelmasta kärsivälle kissalle, ja Jeff hoitaa loukkaantuneen tiikerin. Denverin intohimoisin ja periksiantamattomin eläinlääkäri Jeff Young luotsaa Planned Pethood Plus -klinikkaansa suurella sydämellä. Dr. Jeff tiimeineen hoitaa kaikenkarvaisia eläimiä sekä klinikalla että siirtymällä tarpeen tullen paikan päälle syrjäisiin kohteisiin. Iso-Britannia 2017

programme.title: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End
programme.desc: What's Up Dock?. Lucas rakentaa ystävälle isoa uima-allasta. Unelmien takapihalle syntyy laituri, vesiputouksia, tulipesä, audiovisuaalinen viihdekeskus ja uimabaari! The crew turns a koi pond project into a backyard oasis for a family and their fish in Siesta Key. Later, they transform an old pool into a natural lagoon. Yhdysvallat 2018

programme.title: Animal ER
programme.desc: Episode 4. Nelivuotias maltanterrieri Therodore saapuu sairaalaan mystisten oireiden takia. Koiran tilan heiketessä lääkärit tuskailevat diagnoosin kanssa. 2010

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: All Falls Down. Alaskan erämaassa asuu villinä syntynyt ja kasvanut perhe. Perheenjäsenet ovat riippuvaisia toisistaan selvitäkseen karussa ympäristössä. 2016

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Gator vs. Dog. Teksasin riistanvalvojat etsivät 250-kiloista alligaattoria, joka vainoaa lähiöaluetta. Luonnonsuojelualueelta löytyy piilotettu marijuanaviljelmä. Yhdysvallat 2015

programme.title: I'm Alive
programme.desc: Koskettavia kertomuksia ihmisistä, jotka taistelivat eläinten hyökkäyksiä vastaan uhmaten kuolemaa ja välittämättä esteistä tai seuraamuksista. 2009

programme.title: Project Grizzly
programme.desc: Bears On The Run. Jeffin epätavalliset metsästystunnit eivät valmista Bobia ja Screechiä metsästämään ruokaa luonnossa. Eläimet taitavat kuitenkin oppia taidon ihan itse. 2016

programme.title: Animal Cops Miami
programme.desc: Manatee Rescue. Manaatin räpylän dramaattinen pelastus paljastaa salaisuuden. Tutkija Casadevall etsii salametsästäjiä, joiden hyökkäyksissä on kuollut useita karjaeläimiä. 2010

programme.title: Akvaariomestarit
programme.desc: Shark Byte. Indianaan rakentuu yksi kaikkien aikojen suurimmista hai-altaista. Siihen muutetaan yli sata kahden eri hai-lajin edustajaa, mutta myös itse altaan siirtäminen on valtava urakka. Yhdysvallat 2017

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: When Mr. Ratburn challenges the class to find the perfect food for surviving on a desert island, everyone picks potato chips or ice cream! D.W. is told a secret and quickly learns that keeping one is a lot harder than she thought.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur Writes A Story/Arthur's Lost Dog
programme.desc: Struggling with a school assignment, Arthur decides that his regular life is just too boring to write about. And, Arthur is the only one who believes in the superior intelligence of his dog. But even Arthur gets confused when Pal runs away.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy wants a Bouncy Castle at her party, but when her favorite cherry tree is cut down to make room for it, she starts to have regrets. Francine and Muffy scheme to set up their older siblings Chip and Catherine, but plans go awry.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Arthur discovers that Grandma Thora is a marbles champion, he trains with her so he can beat all his friends. Then, Brain doesn't believe in superstitions, so when he has a string of bad luck, he's stunned.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster's Second Chance/Arthur and the Whole Truth
programme.desc: With the help of a little time travel, Buster turns back the clock to see what his life would be like if he were a genius. Arthur isn't happy when he discovers that Buster has been telling him some white lies, just to spare his feelings.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: After visiting The Elwood City Times, Francine decides to start her own paper--The Frensky Star! The tabloid is a success--until all her friends stop speaking to her. Somebody stole D.W.'s backpack!! Who is this fluffy unicorn thief?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Will Fern give up her dreams of being a writer just because of one silly rejection? Buster tells the story of a missing cereal box on his all-new podcast. Will he be able to find the thief--and in the process--the truth?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Flea to Be You and Me/Kiss and Tell
programme.desc: Pal is itching like crazy and the culprit is Pepe, an Italian circus flea. Then, Emily returns from her summer in Paris with the amazing news that she's been kissed .... by a boy! Now can D.W. find her own Prince Charming?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Last Tough Customer/Brain's Chess Mess

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Home Sweet Home/Do You Believe in Magic

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Everyone at school is speaking their own made-up language, and George can't make sense of what anyone is saying. And it's the grand opening of World Girl World, which sells dolls from every country, and every girl in town is thrilled!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen and Fern take a popularity quiz in a magazine and change their personalities to become more likable, but it backfires. And Buster's convinced that his great joke will be the difference between a successful oral report and failure.

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A special episode of Bionic Bunny is interrupted, and Arthur and friends try to remember what comes next. D.W. is excited to be taking care of the class bunny, Larry. But Larry is feeling adventurous and and wanders off.

programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: When Rattles's mom starts dating Archie Vanderloo, Rattles finds himself spending time with his twins, but they don’t have anything in common. Arthur offers to babysit so that his parents can enjoy some peace and quiet in the backyard.

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: When Arthur catches Buster sucking his thumb, Buster worries that Arthur will tell the entire school. Tired of doing chores, Arthur and friends decide to invent their own country. Will this kid-ruled utopia flourish or descend into anarchy?

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: April 9th is a normal day until a fire destroys the teacher's lounge and forces Lakewood Elementary to close. This unexpected event finds creates a wide range of emotional reactions, for Arthur, his friends and teachers, and the community.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Celebrity chef Ming Tsai is judging Lakewood Elementary's first-ever cooking contest, and Arthur thinks he has a shot at winning. Then, Buster volunteers to deliver the school mail and finds out that his new job is actually hard work!

programme.sub-title: Fernlets by Fern/Prunella and the Haunted Locker
programme.desc: Muffy talks Fern into writing poems for a new line of greeting cards which becomes the hit of Elwood City, but booming business causes Fern to burn out. Prunella is assigned a new school locker, which is rumored to be haunted!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's bad enough to wear glasses all the time. But does Arthur have to be the last person in his class to lose his baby teeth? Then, if you think being lost in a humongous department store would scare a four-year-old, think again.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What would happen if Arthur and his friends entered a contest to write stories for their favorite TV show? Then, look out world, D.W. has discovered science! But D.W.'s new-found passion proves that a little knowledge is a dangerous thing.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur is worried that his letters to his new Turkish pen pal, Adil, will be boring. After all, how can Elwood City compare to Arthur's fantastical ideas about Turkey? Bitzi is breaking up with her boyfriend, and Buster is really sad.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: For some reason, Arthur isn't doing very well in school anymore. Maybe he just needs some glasses? Problem is, Arthur hates having to wear them. And it's school picture day and Muffy is determined that Francine will look her best.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: You think running a marathon is hard? Try babysitting for the Terrible Tibble Twins. Next, Arthur's family is hosting the once-a-year-is-more-than-enough family reunion. But a major thunderstorm turns this into a reunion to remember.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and Buster have always been best friends, but when a leaky roof forces Arthur to study in Buster's room, they discover that they make better friends than roommates. Arthur's ecstatic when he wins free concert tickets on the radio.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster Isn't Buying It/One Ornery Critter
programme.desc: Aliens, conspiracy theories, the megatoad--Buster believes in everything, until his favorite show gets cancelled for false reporting. Dogs love Arthur! Well, except Carrot Cake. Can Arthur win over this picky pup?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy's Dad gives her concert tickets, she couldn't be more excited--until she discovers that she's going to the opera. And Arthur aced five quizzes in a row! But his luck runs out when Mom takes a new job.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster Spaces Out/The Long Road Home
programme.desc: Inspired by footage of the moon landing, Buster wants to go to outer space someday! For now, it'd be cool to build and launch a rocket! Then, after costing Lakewood Elementary the win in a relay race, George wants to redeem himself.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Kids Are From Earth, Parents Are From Pluto/Nerves Of Steal
programme.desc: It’s Lakewood Elementary Parents Open House! How will the kids survive a whole evening of their parents' embarrassing antics? Buster is the only kid in Elwood City who doesn't have a Cybertoy, so he decides to 'borrow' one from the store.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Last of Mary Moo Cow/Bitzi's Beau
programme.desc: When Mary Moo Cow is cancelled, D.W. is devastated. How can television--or life as she knows it--ever be the same? Buster hasn't yet met Bitzi's new boyfriend, but he fears the worst. What if he is a Mom-stealer?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur is not too sure he's ready for a new baby in the house. What do babies do besides cry? Then, living with a baby is no picnic. Just how long will Baby Kate be hanging around, anyway? And who would even miss D.W. if she ran away?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy posts a goofy video of Francine on the Muffington Post, Francine worries she will become the laughing stock of the entire school. And it's the 1st Annual Lakewood Derby and Muffy's revved up!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: D.W.'s Deer Friend/Buster Hits the Books
programme.desc: The Reads go on a camping trip, and D.W. wants to bring a little bit of nature back home--a rather large deer named Walter! Next, Buster got through school without ever reading a book. But now he has to read one in just a week!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: So Funny I Forgot to Laugh/The Best Day Ever
programme.desc: Arthur thinks his jokes about Sue Ellen's new sweater are in good fun but Sue Ellen's feelings are hurt. Has Arthur become a bully? Everyone is reminiscing about their "best days." Except Arthurs. Is it possible he doesn't have one?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Carl's Concerto/Too Much of a Good Thing
programme.desc: Carl has agreed to play the accordion for George's puppet show. But his routines are getting in the way of rehearsals. Buster enlists Binky's help to keep him from gorging on delicious Tuvaluna cookies. Will Buster's self-control crumble?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur Makes A Movie/Go to Your Room!
programme.desc: Too young to see a real "James Hound" movie, the kids decide they'll make a film of their own. Next, how would YOU like to be four years old and completely misunderstood by your parents? And then be sent to your room for ten whole minutes?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Brain dreams of being the first to spot a rare bird species called the green-tailed grebe, making him famous. Arthur and Buster's friendship is put to the test when Arthur gives away a present that Buster had given him for his birthday.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Attention Lakewood Elementary! There's a new sheriff—er--hallway monitor-in town, and his name is George Lundgren. Ladonna Compson is friendly, funny, and full of personality. Everyone likes her! At least, that's what she thought.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy embarks on a quest to find her long lost imaginary friend. And then it's Catherine's 16th birthday, and Francine has been cordially UN-invited to the party.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Binky discovers that he's allergic to peanuts, he has so many questions, but learns that the best way not to go nuts is to be well informed and to understand his allergy. Much to his horror, Brain gets a "B-" on a test.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Gets Her Goose Cooked/Best of The Nest
programme.desc: Sue Ellen is the champion of the popular Internet game, Virtualgoose.com, but she’s become obsessed! And now the gang has moved onto Best of the Nest. Will any of his friends be willing to forgo their computers for a real, live adventure?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur The Wrecker/Arthur and The True Francine
programme.desc: Arthur always seems to wreck things, and this time it's Mom's computer. Can he get it fixed before Mom finds out? Then, Muffy A. Crosswire and Francine are absolute best friends, despite their rather obvious differences.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur has a hard time resisting sweets, and one evening his overindulgence wins him an upset stomach and some 'Grimm' dreams. Arthur and D.W. loved it when Grandpa Dave came to visit--but now he only wants to sleep and play checkers.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Cried Comet/Arthur and Los Vecinos
programme.desc: Buster is convinced that he's seen real UFO's, and he uses Muffy's fancy new telescope to get the proof. Then, Mr. Sipple from next door is moving away and Arthur wonders--who will be the new neighbors?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: There’s a mock election in Mr. Ratburn's class, but Muffy takes it seriously. How far will she go to win? Francine can't believe it. She gets in trouble no matter what she does -- thanks to the new nosy next-door neighbor!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Attack Of The Turbo Tibbles/D.W. Tricks The Tooth Fairy
programme.desc: If you think the Tibbles are bad now, imagine what they'd be like if they had super powers! Then, D.W. needs money, quick. When she tries to pull a fast one on the Tooth Fairy, will Arthur have to pay?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Case of the Girl with the Long Face/The Substitute Arthur
programme.desc: Fern's been feeling low and no one can figure out why. Luckily, Buster Baxter is on the case! With Arthur out of town, Buster is on the hunt for a new best friend, but he only wants to play games HIS way. Will Buster learn to compromise?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster’s Uncle Bob – portrayed by special guest R.L. Stine – comes to visit and tells Buster a spooky bedtime story. Then, Cheikh learns that he and his family will become American citizens!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Binky's family has decided to adopt a little girl from China. The thought of a baby sister makes Binky happy, until he realized there are some changes in store. It’s a lot harder than he thought, but it has its rewards too.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and his friends commemorate their 100th episode in style! Mr. Ratburn's class is chosen to stage a musical tribute to Elwood City for its centennial celebration, which quickly becomes a drama behind the curtain!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Grandma Thora teaches Arthur to knit and he's really into this new hobby. But…he's a kid! And a boy! Knitting is a grandma thing, right? And, Muffy wants to rock the fashion world, but creating a fad is a lot harder than it looks.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Butler Did...What?/The Trouble with Trophies
programme.desc: Bailey is missing! Muffy discovers a series of clues and is left wondering, who exactly IS Bailey? Then, everyone loves getting trophies, right? It turns out that Fern could not care less about them.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The World of Tomorrow/Is There a Doctor in the House?
programme.desc: Since Binky's repeating third grade, he's totally dreading Mr. Ratburn's annual class sleepover at the Science Museum. Arthur and D.W. face the ultimate challenge when Mom gets a bad cold and then gives it to Dad!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buenas Noches, Vicita/Prunella Packs It In
programme.desc: Vicita Molina has lost her favorite bedtime book – can Arthur help her re-create it? Prunella is already starting to think about college! Will she crack under the heavy load or will she learn to relax and do the things she actually enjoys?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When D.W. discovers that she can get her own library card, she rejoices at the world of books waiting for her. And, is it ever okay to hit someone? Sometimes you just get so mad, you wanna....pow! Right??

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Toy Trouble/Spar for the Course
programme.desc: It's a race to the toy store after Arthur realizes he may have given away his chance at 2 million dollars! Unless Muffy, Buster, and Binky can comprise, they'll be stuck with a boring windmill at the new 18th hole at the mini golf course.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. wants to be the first person to set foot on Mars! But what if scary purple aliens eat her? Who's responsible for cracking Dad's cake platter? DUN-DUN! All the evidence points to Arthur!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad fight over spilled milk, Arthur and D.W. fear the worst. Is it Arthur's fault or D.W.'s? Then, turning five is a major, big deal event! But D.W. worries that she fribbled away her preschool years on meaningless pursuits.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Adds It Up/Wish You Were Here

programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: The latest book about everyone's favorite boy wizard--Henry Skreever--is finally out! Every kid in town is lining up to get it, except Prunella, who's ordered a limited edition from England. Ever wonder what Baby Kate and Pal are thinking?

programme.title: Meaban and Moo
programme.desc: Bidh Linda a’ tadhal air a caraidean Meaban is Moo sa bhothan aca gus dùbhlain spòrsail a chur romhpa. Seo tha i ag iarraidh orra trì diofar ghlasraich a lorg fhad ’s a tha iad cuideachd a' dèanamh deiseil airson partaidh Oidhche Shamhna. Tha treallaich gu leòr sa bhothan agus feumaidh Meaban is Moo a dhol a rùrach! Linda visits her friends Meaban and Moo at their hut to set them fun challenges. She tasks them with finding three different vegetables while they get ready for a Halloween party. Their hut is full of junk, so Meaban and Moo just need to have a good rummage!

programme.title: Leum Suas air an Sguaib/Room on the Broom
programme.desc: Tha Lìosaidh NicÌosaig, a' bhana-bhuidseach, 's an cat gu dòigheil a' seòladh air sguab. Tha a' ghaoth mhòr ag èirigh 's tha Lìosaidh a' call a h-ad, an rioban a tha na falt, 's an t-slatag a tha na làimh. Ge-ta, tha triùir charaidean eile a' nochdadh a bheir taic dhi. The witch and the cat fly through the sky on a broomstick. The wind picks up, the witch drops her hat, her bow and her wand. Fortunately, three more friends come to her aid. Can they rescue the witch from the dragon and will there be room on the broom for all?

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Le taic bho chàch, tha Pipp a’ dol na banrigh, le crùn, cathair agus parèid rìoghail. With a bit of Froggie help, Pipp turns into a queen with crown, throne and royal parade.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Grandad is in Gran's good books for tidying his desk, but he tells Stan that it wasn't him! Who are the mystery tidy-uppers and how did they get in? Tha Gran toilicht' leis an t-Seanair leis gun do sgioblaich e 'n deasg aige, ach e 'g ràdh ri Dan nach b' esan a sgioblaich e. Ach cò an luchd-glanaidh dìomhair, agus ciamar a nochd iad an seo?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein is a charaidean gann de dh’airgead, is leis nach eil ann an airgead ach pìosan beaga pàipeir le dealbhan orra, tha iad uile a’ co-dhùnadh gun cruthaich iad an t-airgead aca fhèin, is gun ceannaich iad na thogras iad. Because they are a little short of money, and considering cash notes are only little papers with drawings on them, Petit and his friends decide to create their own money and buy anything they want.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Martainn Mac an t-Saoir a’ leughadh Am Balach a bha ag Ithe Leabhraichean. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Oliver Jeffers agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. A bedtime story for young children. Martin MacIntyre reads Am Balach a bha ag Ithe Leabhraichean, written and illustrated by Oliver Jeffers and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: Calum: Cogadh nan Comhlan
programme.desc: Tha Calum airson a chòmhlann aige a thoirt à Glaschu dhan Òban airson blàr mòr ciùil a tha dol aig a' Mhòd Nàiseanta Rìoghail. Ach, le tòrr fharpaisean agus gainead tìde, chan eil cùisean a' dol mar bu chòir. Leis nach eil e furasda còmhlan a làimhseachadh aig na h-amannan as fheàrr, saoil ciamar a thèid dhaibh leis na dùbhlain mhòra a th' air thoiseach orra... Calum aims to take his band from Glasgow to Oban for a major musical battle at the Royal National Mòd. However, with numerous competitions and time constraints, things aren't going according to plan. Managing a band is never easy even in the best of times - how will they cope with the significant challenges that lie ahead?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: The beul gun phutan Lynette ag adhbharachadh cunnart airson Elaina. Ciamar a gheibh Belle, Sebastian agus na caraidean air cùisean a shàbhaladh? Lynette’s loose lips puts Elaina in danger. How can Belle, Sebastian and the gang save the day?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Leis an tuathanach agus Bitzer a' falbh a-mach airson latha còmhla ri chèile, tha Seonaidh a' gabhail a' chothruim a bhith os cionn ghnothaichean. Ach tha e a' mothachadh gu math luath nach eil an obair cho furasta 's a bha e an dùil. When the farmer decides it is time he and Bitzer head out for a bit of man and dog time, Shaun seizes his chance to take charge. He soon discovers that the job is not quite as easy as he first thought.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha Flix 'son dearbhadh g’ eil easan na shàr chat feireil – dìreach mar athair, Zeno. Chan eil a nàmhaid, Burma, dol a dhèanamh chùisean furasta dha, ge-tà! Flix wants to prove that he’s an ultimate outdoor cat - just like his dad, Zeno. However his nemesis Burma isn’t going to make things easy for him!

programme.title: Golf: Mun Cuairt Alba
programme.desc: Cùrsaichean ann an Lodainn an Ear, is coidse le comhairle. The 15th Redan hole at North Berwick and golf tips from Keil Beveridge.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop a’ leantainn oirre gar toirt tro thuilleadh cheumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Joy Dunlop continues to guide us through further steps to speak Gaelic.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets Ian Smith in the village he was brought up, before they head along one of Tiree’s most famous beaches. As they walk along the coast, Ian reflects on his youth and the people that impacted him. Ian discusses how the Tiree music scene shaped him and brought him success as a box player, and he shares his passion for the island and his pride in setting up the only distillery in Tiree. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Coinnichidh Ramsay ri Iain Mac a’ Ghobhainn sa bhaile san d’rugadh e mas dèan iad air tè de na tràighean as iomraitiche ann an Tiriodh. Meòirichidh Iain air làithean òige agus na daoine bu mhotha a thug buaidh air a bheatha. Leis cho cudromach ‘s a tha ceòl air eilean Thiriodh, innsidh Iain man bhuaidh a bh’aige seo air fhèin agus mar a chuidich e a bhith cho soirbheachail le cluich a’ bhogsa. Bidh an dà chuid a mheas air an eilean agus a mhoit man aon taigh-stàile san eilean fhaighinn stèidhichte follaiseach. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Sailm nan Daoine
programme.desc: Tha an ceòladair Rob MacNeacail air turas gus cumhachd seinn nan salm Gàidhlig a sgaoileadh. Musician Rob MacNeacail is on a mission to spread the power of Gaelic psalm singing.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: The vast landscape of the Cairngorms attracts thousands each year. Coinneach Rankin sets out on a multi-day expedition to learn why its vast mountains are a paradise for climbers, runners and so many others. Along with his partner, Coinneach races up one of the highest mountains in Scotland, undertakes a classic multi-pitch climb, and spends the night in a tiny bothy built in the 1960s. Tàlaidh cruth-tìre aibheiseach a’ Mhonaidh Ruaidh na mìltean gach bliadhna. Cuiridh Coinneach MacFhraing aghaidh air turas grunn làithean gus tuigsinn carson a tha sreapadairean, luchd-coise agus eile cho measail air na beanntan seo. An cuideachd deagh charaid, thèid Coinneach na dheann suas tè de na beanntan as àirde an Alba, dìreidh e slighe-sreapa fhada agus cuiridh e seachad na h-oidhche ann am bothan a thogadh ‘sna seasgadan. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: A year after a major fire, archaeologists and scientists examine the battered stones of Notre-Dame in Paris.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le December ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform December in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing a’ cluich geama le fòn-làimhe Flop, chaneil rudan a’ dol mar bu chòir oir tha am fòn-làimhe a' briseadh nuair a tha e dol na sgeing air an làr. An àite seo innse do Flop, tha Bing ga chuir dhan bhiona. Tha e faireachdainn cho dona mun seo ach tha e ag ionnsachadh gum feum e innse mar a thachair. When Bing is playing a game with Flop’s mobile phone, he accidentally drops the mobile and it breaks. Instead of telling Flop, he throws it in the bin. He feels upset about it all and learns that it’s best to tell the truth.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing aig cuirm sa phàirc, tha còir aige 'n oidhch' a chrìochnachadh ach tha e air bhioran agus tha e fàs cho diùid. Ge-tà, le taic bho charaidean, tha e faighinn seachad air na duilgheadasan sin agus tha e a' seinn Òran a’ Bhogha-fhroise. When Bing is at a show in the park, he is extremely nervous as he is meant to be singing the finale. However, with help from his friends, Bing gets over all his insecurities and sings the Rainbow Song.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha Ben a' leughadh sgeulachd dha na h-Abadas mus tig iad dhan leabaidh. Aig deireadh na sgeòil, tha iad airson an geama fhaclan a chlcuich, 's tha Hari ga fhaighinn fhèin sa ghàrradh a' coimhead son cailleach-oidhche. Before going to bed, Ben reads Seren, Hari and Ela a story. When the story ends, the Abadas decide to play the word game and this sends Hari to a windy garden looking for an owl.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ‘S e latha socair a th’ ann air an eilean, latha math airson a bhith dìomhain. Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ crochadh hamag, is tha tòrr spòrs aca a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre. Tha na Boga-bogadaich a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre cuideachd, ach tha iad air an caith suas dhan adhar is a’ dol a-mach à sealladh. Càite an deach iad? Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ falbh a’ lorg nam Boga-bogadach. It is a lazy day on the Island. Abney, Teal and Neep put up a hammock and have a great time trying to get into it. The Poc-Pocs join in the fun but are thrown up into the air and disappear. Where have they gone? Abney, Teal and Neep go on a Poc-Poc hunt.

programme.title: ’S E Iasg a Th’Annam (I’m a Fish)
programme.desc: Ged a tha riochd caran neo-àbhaisteach air a’ Bhagan-mhara, tha e den bheachd gu bheil cuid eile ann an tha nas grainnde buileach na iad. Although the Blobfish looks rather unusual, he says that there are other fish who are even more aesthetically displeasing than him.

programme.title: Peataichean/Pets
programme.desc: Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ coinneachadh ri clann agus a’ faighinn a-mach mu mar a tha iad a’ coimhead às dèidh agus a’ cluich cuide rim peataichean aig an taigh. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha Eilidh a’ cèilidh air Emily agus na coineanaich aice, Syrius agus Seumas a tha beothail agus bòidheach. Gheibh sinn a-mach barrachd mu bhith a’ coimhead às dèidh coineanaich agus mu na rudan snog is spòrsail a bhios iad a’ dèanamh còmhla. Gheibh sinn cuideachd comhairle agus fiosrachadh bho Eilidh fhèin mu bhith a’ làimhseachadh, ag oideachadh agus a’ coimhead às dèidh peataichean. Eilidh Cormack meets young children who are pet owners. Together they show, tell and share how they care for, play and interact with their pets at home. In this episode, Eilidh visits Emily and her adorable rabbits, Syrius and Seumas. We find out how to look after rabbits and about all the lovely stuff Emily, Syrius and Seumas get up to together. Eilidh also shares fun and interesting facts along with advice on looking after pets at home; including how best to handle, train and feed them.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Dòmhnall Ruadh a’ leughadh An Ròn Beag. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Janis Mackay agus a dhealbhachadh le Gabby Grant. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Donald Smith reads An Ròn Beag by Janis Mackay, illustrated by Gabby Grant and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Gealach na Durraige Guirme a' nochdadh, tha i a’ taladh dhurragan gorma a tha glè thearc, ach blasta, agus ma dh'itheas Gumbal tè dhiubh, tha a h-uile càil a' dol ceàrr! When the Blue Grub Moon appears, it brings out a very rare but delicious grub and if a Gumbal eats one, things go wrong!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Troig is Bonns a’ feuchainn ri Gumbal-sgluidseadh, tha tubaist ann is tha iad suainte ri chèile. Feumar obrachadh còmhla ach ciamar a gheibh na caraidean air adhart leis a seo? When Troig and Bonns try to gumblesplat, they accidentally get entwined. They have to work together, but how will the friends get on with this?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Leis an tuathanach agus Bitzer a' falbh a-mach airson latha còmhla ri chèile, tha Seonaidh a' gabhail a' chothruim a bhith os cionn ghnothaichean. Ach tha e a' mothachadh gu math luath nach eil an obair cho furasta 's a bha e an dùil. When the farmer decides it is time he and Bitzer head out for a bit of man and dog time, Shaun seizes his chance to take charge. He soon discovers that the job is not quite as easy as he first thought.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ dol gu coinneamh nan Sgùdan Sporais ’son a’ chiad turas, is tha bràiste ri chosnadh. Tha i fhèin ’s a caraidean dol a sgioblachadh sa phàirc. Chan eil gnothaichean ag obrachadh mar a shaoileadh tu, ge-ta! Hilda goes to a Sparrow Scouts meeting for the first time, and there is a badge to be earned. She and her friends tidy up in the park, but things don’t work out as you would imagine!

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ cleachdadh mustard eadar-dhealaichte gus truinnsearan inntinneach a chruthachadh. Tha ùidh aig Ruairidh ann am mustard a tha ga dhèanamh sna Hearadh agus ag iarraidh air Ùisdean reòiteag a dhèanamh leis! Tha Ùisdean a’ toirt sùil air ais air reasabaidh traidiseanta airson slios feòla le mustard, air a ghabhail le buntàta Hasselback Ruairidh. Tha Ruairidh cuideachd ag ullachadh Cearc Supreme agus a’ cur crìoch air a’ phrògram le Carpaccio Bhiotais. The lads use different mustards to make a variety of dishes. Ruaridh is inspired by a Harris-made mustard and asks Uisdean to make ice cream, using the mustard! Uisdean looks back at a traditional recipe for Flank with mustard, accompanied by Ruaridh’s Hasselback potatoes. Ruairidh also prepares a classic, chicken supreme, and finishes off the episode with a beetroot carpaccio. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop leads us on our Gaelic learning journey. Dr Teàrlach Wilson joins her in the studio, and Calum Maclean visits Govan while on the hunt for a collection of stones.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Cidsin Granaidh Chalanais
programme.desc: Gregor MacLeod takes on the classics shortbread and marmalade. Grannie has five recipes for shortbread alone, but Gregor has to pick just one.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: In 2019, a catastrophic fire threatened Notre-Dame’s structure. Analysing the vaults of the building, researchers unveil its history and decipher the secrets of its past resistance.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Mar annlann a tha na thrèat air leth, tha Abigail a' dèanamh Briosgaidean Seasaman Tahini. Glè, glè bhlasta, a' brùchdadh le deagh bhlas is teòclaid geal! For a splendid accompaniment treat, Abigail makes tahini sesame cookies. Very tasty, packed with flavour and white chocolate! In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Sailm nan Daoine
programme.desc: Tha an ceòladair Rob MacNeacail air turas gus cumhachd seinn nan salm Gàidhlig a sgaoileadh. Musician Rob MacNeacail is on a mission to spread the power of Gaelic psalm singing.

programme.title: OMC!
programme.desc: A sketch show featuring a collection of comic characters, spoofs, inappropriate dates and a snapshot of the past. Written by and starring the very best in emerging and established comic talent. Featuring Iain Beggs, Darren Maclean, Carina Macleod, Claire Frances MacNeil, Hannah McKirdy, Lana Pheutan and David Walker. Includes sharpened words between mother and daughter in law, a new guy at work discovers what makes the office tick, and it’s eyes down for a coveted prize at the bingo. Anns an treas prògram bho shreath ùr OMC! chì sinn tuilleadh sgeidsichean loma-làn charactaran èibhinn, suidheachaidhean neònach agus ‘spoofs’ gun shamhail bho n sgrìobhadairean is cleasaichean as fheàrr a th’ann. An turas sa mòmaidean ain-fhoiseil le màthair cèile, duilgheadasan cainnt ann an obair ùr, agus duais air leth ri thogail aig am bingo! In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Atlantis: Las reglas de compromiso
programme.desc: Cuando Jasón se entera del compromiso de Ariadna con Heptarión, se le rompe el corazón. Sin nada que perder, participa en un brutal torneo de lucha para honrar las nupcias.

programme.title: Atlantis: Las furias
programme.desc: Encargados de escoltar un valioso cargamento a través del desierto, la pandilla viaja hacia lo desconocido con una destartalada caravana de extraños.

programme.title: Atlantis: Caja de Pandora
programme.desc: Cuando Medusa es secuestrada por un cruel prestamista, Kyros, exige que Hércules recupere un artefacto precioso y poderoso del inframundo a cambio de su vida.

programme.title: Atlantis: El precio de la esperanza
programme.desc: Los chicos corren por sus vidas cuando se convierten en presas de una brutal persecución. Su coraje se pone a prueba hasta el límite, hasta que llega un salvavidas de una fuente inesperada.

programme.title: Atlantis: Dolores de hambre
programme.desc: Jasón comete un error fatal al comer carne de sacrificio y comienza a exhibir un comportamiento extraño. Hércules y Pitágoras deben salvar a su amigo mientras las cosas se descontrolan.

programme.title: Atlantis: Tocado por los Dioses - Parte 1
programme.desc: Jasón recuerda su promesa a Circe y su sombría advertencia si no cumple con su pacto. No tiene más remedio que actuar: Jasón debe matar a la reina.

programme.title: Atlantis: Tocado por los Dioses - Parte 2
programme.desc: Pasífae sentencia a Ariadna a una espantosa ejecución. Con Jasón como su última esperanza, depende de él y sus amigos intentar salvar la vida de Ariadna.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un nuevo amanecer: Primera parte
programme.desc: Mientras el reino está al borde del colapso, la lucha por el poder es sangrienta y brutal. Con un futuro sombrío, solo hay una persona que puede ayudar: Jasón.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un nuevo amanecer: Segunda parte
programme.desc: Pasífae pone sitio a la Atlántida y la ciudad parece a punto de caer. La última esperanza restante recae en Jasón, Hércules y Pitágoras, pero están librando una batalla propia.

programme.title: Atlantis: Telemón
programme.desc: Mientras Jasón lucha por la gloria en el campo del torneo, Ariadna se embarca en su propia batalla privada. El suyo es un concurso de cabeza sobre corazón, pero solo ella puede decidir cuál triunfará.

programme.title: Atlantis: El matrimonio de las mentes verdaderas
programme.sub-title: El matrimonio de las mentes verdaderas
programme.desc: A medida que avanzan los planes para la boda real, Ariadna debe emprender un viaje a Egina, la tierra natal de Telemon. Pero Jasón no es el único que teme por la seguridad de la reina.

programme.title: Atlantis: El día de los Muertos
programme.desc: La pandilla se encuentra dispersa alrededor de una antigua necrópolis. Y pronto se dan cuenta de que no están solos: el espacio está repleto de un ejército mágico de muertos vivientes.

programme.title: Atlantis: Las hermanas grises
programme.desc: Mientras Ariadna yace en su lecho de muerte, la culpa de Jasón es casi insoportable. Decide hacer todo lo posible para salvarla y se embarca en una peligrosa búsqueda hacia lo desconocido.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.sub-title: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.desc: Cuando la noticia llega a Pasífae sobre el inminente matrimonio de Ariadna y Jasón, está aterrorizada de que Atlantis se pierda para siempre y decide hacer todo lo posible para detener la unión.

programme.title: Atlantis: La locura de Hércules
programme.desc: A medida que Pasífae aumenta su control sobre la Atlántida, el futuro parece sombrío. Hércules sabe que solo hay una forma de salvar a sus amigos: Medusa. ¿Es un riesgo que está dispuesto a correr?

programme.title: Atlantis: La mirada de la Gorgona
programme.desc: Pasífae se ha apoderado de Atlantis y solo una cosa es segura: se necesitará un sacrificio de proporciones inimaginables para arreglar las cosas.

programme.desc: Antiques Roadshow äger rum på Newby Hall i Yorkshire, där fynden inkluderar ett spännande brev från Lord Nelson, som artigt svarade hans optiker bara veckor före slaget vid Trafalgar. Det finns också en förlovningsring som hämtades i en pantbank och en del av setet från Live Aid, räddad från en container. Den var bekant för de som tillhörde en viss generation och användes som bakgrund för en mängd intervjuer med världens största popstjärnor, från Bob Geldof till Bono och Brian May, under konserten 1985. Vi ser en extraordinär samling australiska artefakter och hör hur livet bland ursprungsbefolkningar förändrade två systrars liv. Dessutom lanserar Bradford Museums and Galleries en uppmaning att hitta de familjer som finns med på tusentals foton i sitt arkiv.

programme.desc: Join host Iain Stirling for the most nail-biting episode yet – a celebration of skill, teamwork and sheer determination. It all began with seven hopeful pairs of newbies, their pros and a beach full of promises. Now, only one team will triumph before Mother Nature wipes the slate clean. St Andrews’ stunning West Sands becomes the sandy beach battleground as three teams of sand-sculpting hopefuls face their toughest challenge yet. Our finalists – Athena and Rachel, Shane and Lisa, and Yusuf and Johannes – have just six hours to create the most ambitious sculptures of their lives before the North Sea sweeps in one last time to claim their masterpieces. Fittingly, the theme is Ultimate Sandcastles – a test of skill, creativity and resilience. Judges Sadie and Jamie are demanding height, arches, spiral staircases and that elusive wow factor. But will our sculptors play it safe or push boundaries to deliver something truly spectacular? Expect drama, collapses, creative differences and plenty of emotion.

Paul Martin visits Cromer to find out about the RNLI’s most decorated lifeboatman.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob travel to the River Ribble in Lancashire for one last fish with their little canine pal, Ted. The beautiful river Ribble runs through the rolling hills of the Yorkshire Dales, onwards to Lancashire before meeting the Irish Sea in Lytham. With the river in good health, Paul and Bob hope to catch a good chub or a mighty barbel on this stretch of the water, while Ted hopes to taste Bob’s Lancashire hotpot.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Experts claim that artificial intelligence has begun to exhibit early signs of agency. What does the rise of the superintelligence mean for society? Is humanity on a path to superintelligence or hurtling towards self-destruction? Professor Hannah Fry explores the promises and threats of AI, considering the ways in which superintelligent machines could help humanity as well as the ways in which they could be a hindrance. Over the course of the episode, a range of experts discuss the future of humanity in the age of AI.

programme.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programme.desc: Hannah Fry takes a look at the bank card, the digital key to accessing cash, and finds out how its extraordinary innovations have some surprising and sinister origins.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The Bear Ladies restore a stuffed monkey that turned royal heads. The team also fix a cake topper emblematic of a circus childhood and a Second World War helmet that survived the Blitz.

programme.title: Murder in Belfast: Sisters Seeking Justice
programme.desc: The killing of Robert McCartney erupted from nowhere: a Sunday night at a city pub ended in a gang attack and murder. As evidence vanishes, Robert’s family aren’t getting any answers. There is a race to find out what happened from the survivor of the stabbing - but the police aren’t the only organisation trying to talk to witnesses.

programme.title: Ellie & Natasia
programme.desc: A routine driving lesson takes a bizarre, surreal turn; a game show called Find the Snakes is destined to sweep the nation; contemporary politicians are introduced to a literal public arena; vape sommeliers treat e-liquid profiles with the gravity of a fine Bordeaux; two ultra-wealthy girls are determined to get exactly what they want; and two restaurant-goers take their love of food to an intense extreme. Featuring an appearance from Asim Chaudry.

programme.desc: John Simpson, in discussion with the BBC's unparalleled range of experts across the world, explores the challenges facing Ukraine in the war against Russia as winter approaches, analyses the causes of the widespread protests in France, and looks at the unexpected victory for President Lula in the Brazilian election.

programme.title: Escaping Idi Amin
programme.desc: In August 1972, Idi Amin is 18 months into his dictatorship. Supporters hail the new president - a former boxer and soldier - as a saviour, and his rise to power is greeted with celebration and hope across Uganda. But beneath the apparent social harmony, resentment runs deep. Until 1962, Uganda had been a protectorate of the British - with the British very much at the top of the pile, Africans at the bottom and Asians in the middle. Despite ten years of independence, many Africans feel that they are denied opportunities to improve their position in society. Idi Amin decides to exploit their feelings and increase support for his regime. With one announcement from the president, the lives of 80,000 people in Uganda are changed forever. In a bid to cement his leadership, Idi Amin announces that all Ugandan Asians must leave the country within 90 days. Will they be able to flee on their British passports?

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Bordeaux’s world-famous vineyards are undergoing a revival as vintners seek to update their wines by introducing new technology and reinventing older traditions. Eva visits Saint-Emilion, where wine production began 1,000 years ago, and enjoys unusual wine pairings - a deep red with fish and a buttery white with cheese. But Bordeaux isn’t just about wine; it has superb produce, including succulent duck and tender beef as well as 200-million-year-old caviar, served with signature bordelaise sauces.

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The seasons are changing at Longmeadow, and Monty is planting spring-flowering bulbs to provide colour and interest in the months ahead. It’s also time to clear the greenhouse to make space for winter storage. Adam Frost visits RHS Harlow Carr to see how the newly renovated borders are flourishing. Arit Anderson talks to members of the Coco Collective, who grow and cook food from their inner-city allotment, and Sue Kent is at home creating a new planting scheme for next spring. In Oxfordshire, grower Andy Howard shares his passion for the heritage apples thriving in his back garden micro nursery.

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: See Hear celebrates the beautiful game, exploring deaf football, the fight for accessibility and the inspiring people breaking down barriers on and off the pitch. In the studio, presenter Ahmed Mudawi welcomes Oliver Eadsforth, a passionate advocate for deaf football who works with the England and Great Britain teams, supporting players and helping develop the game on and off the pitch. Oliver reflects on his lifelong love of football, from playing goalkeeper at school and university to taking on roles in administration, player development and international football. He discusses the progress made in deaf sport, the importance of having a voice in decision-making and why more opportunities are needed for deaf people to become coaches and leaders.

programme.desc: Game show presented by Rick Edwards in which players score points by answering questions correctly. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Comedian Jason Manford hosts an exciting, fast-paced quiz show, where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize. Who will swipe their way to victory?

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s exploration of Essex reaches Chelmsford. At a huge construction site on the outskirts of the city he discovers Beaulieu Park, the first railway station to be built on the Great Eastern Main Line for over 100 years. Michael learns how the station is designed to alleviate congestion in Chelmsford city centre. At Chelmsford Cathedral, the headquarters of the diocese of Chelmsford, Michael meets the bishop of Chelmsford, the Rt Revd Dr Guli Francis-Dehqani. He discovers one of the largest and most diverse dioceses in England and hears Bishop Guli’s extraordinary personal story of escape from Iran after the Islamic revolution of 1979. Michael continues his rail journey on the Great Eastern Main Line and visits the historic riverside town of Maldon, with its pretty Thames barges. Michael learns about a medieval battle and handles a rare Viking sword. He finishes this leg of his Essex journey in the coastal village of Tollesbury, with its strong maritime heritage and marshy landscape, a haven for birds and wildlife.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Arriving in the Essex market town of Witham, Michael heads into the countryside to visit Terling Place, one of the county’s great country houses. He hears how in the late 19th century, Victorian scientist the 3rd Baron Rayleigh discovered the atmospheric gas argon here. Michael joins the Braintree branch line - aka the Flitch line - and alights at Cressing to visit two huge medieval barns that are thought to be the oldest timber-framed structures in England. At Braintree, Michael learns about the town's wool and silk industries before heading to the Warner and Sons archive, where he discovers a depository of thousands of silk patterns, including two pieces with a royal connection. At Great Bardfield, Michael traces a group of artists including Edward Bawden and Eric Ravilious, who settled in the pretty Essex village from the 1930s onwards. He meets the author of a book on the artists, who now lives in their former home.

programme.title: Secrets of the Aquarium

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

Among the items brought to light are a carved whalebone originally given as a love token to be worn in a corset and a macabre pottery model of a famous Victorian murder scene valued at 5,000 pounds. Also, a bizarre coincidence unites two Beatles collectors.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin visits the Watts Gallery in the heart of the Surrey countryside, where experts David Harper and Thomas Plant are on hand to find a selection of objects to take to auction. programme.desc: In the final case of the series, Danny is joined in the studio by Angela and her daughter Emily. They tell him about events that happened to them in the early 2000s when Emily was a child. A seemingly supernatural presence that began as what Angela thought was an imaginary friend, soon grew into something far more terrifying. Both Emily and her sister became too scared to sleep in their rooms, supposedly beset by the malign presence of an old man who threatened Emily and her family. When Angela’s friends and babysitters began to experience things too, refusing to return to the house, Angela worried for the safety of her daughter. Events escalated to the point where the family felt they were physically in danger. It all seems beyond belief until Danny investigates the history of the house and makes a shocking discovery. As ever, the audience is invited to share their theories and help crack the case.

programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) receive a second opportunity to nail a notorious narcotics dealer as Petrie (Carl Lumbly) and Isbecki (Martin Kove) go 'off-Broadway' to pursue a murder case. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Exit Stage Center (S04E19)
programme.desc: When a famous actress dies, the first assumption is suicide. However, as Cagney and Lacey investigate, they soon discover that she was murdered and everyone in the cast and crew of the play she was in has a probable motive for killing her.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Capitalism
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the murder of a prominent and well-respected Cambodian immigrant lawyer and discover his business might not be as it appears. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Extradition
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are sent to Los Angeles to extradite an old 'perp' as Cagney meets her brother Brian's (guest star David Ackroyd) family for the first time in 12 years. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: A Safe Place
programme.desc: When a vial of plutonium is stolen from a scientist, Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) run up against government barriers trying to locate the lethal radioactive material before the thief becomes terminally ill.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Model Citizen
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the gangland-style murder of a highly respected union leader, making everyone question why a man with a spotless record would be murdered in the first place. Also starring Al Waxman.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Parting Shots
programme.desc: Detective Jonah Newman (guest star Dan Shor) is gunned down in front of his fellow detectives who must find the killer while coming to grips with the loss of their colleague and the danger of their jobs. Starring Sharon Gless and Tyne Daly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: You Call This Plainclothes?
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place involving prostitutes, Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) go undercover in the hopes of finding who keeps killing the women. Also starring Al Waxman, Carl Lumbly, and John Karlen.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Pop Used To Work In Chinatown
programme.sub-title: Pop Used To Work In Chinatown
programme.desc: A Chinatown robbery brings Cagney's retired father back on the beat to show his daughter how to properly conduct an investigation. Guest starring Dick O'Neill as Charlie Cagney. Tyne Daly, Meg Foster, Al Waxman, and Carl Lumbly star.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Beyond The Golden Door
programme.desc: In the hopes of finding a missing child, Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) go undercover as workers in the garment industry and end up helping an undocumented worker from Guatemala find her sister's murderer.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Suffer The Children
programme.desc: Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) become involved in an investigation of child abuse and possible murder when they rescue a four-year-old child from a window ledge. Also starring Al Waxman, Carl Lumbly, and John Karlen.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Better Than Equal
programme.desc: Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) must ignore their feminist sentiments when they are assigned to protect the life of ERA critic, Helen Granger (guest star Julie Adams), who is being harassed by a caller who is threatening her life.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Street Scene
programme.desc: After an elderly man (guest star George Petrie) is involved with the death of a gang member, Cagney and Lacey are accused of racial prejudice as they investigate what happened. The truth is finally revealed with the help of the victim's brother.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Witness To An Incident
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) both have differing recollections when it comes to the events surrounding a young officer fatally shooting a civilian. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels and Carl Lumbly as Mark Petrie.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Witness To An Incident
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) both have differing recollections when it comes to the events surrounding a young officer fatally shooting a civilian. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels and Carl Lumbly as Mark Petrie.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: One Of Our Own
programme.desc: When a fellow police officer is shot and killed in a restaurant, Cagney, and Lacey join in the feverish search for the killer. Meanwhile, Isbecki works to do all that he can to keep the duo off of the precinct's softball team.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: One Of Our Own
programme.desc: When a fellow police officer is shot and killed in a restaurant, Cagney, and Lacey join in the feverish search for the killer. Meanwhile, Isbecki works to do all that he can to keep the duo off of the precinct's softball team.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Beauty Burglars
programme.desc: Detectives Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are assigned to a special task force to investigate a series of beauty salon robberies. The case becomes more complicated when it is discovered that the burglars are posing as police officers.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Beauty Burglars
programme.desc: Detectives Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are assigned to a special task force to investigate a series of beauty salon robberies. The case becomes more complicated when it is discovered that the burglars are posing as police officers.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: High Steel
programme.desc: Harvey (John Karlen) disagrees with the outcome of an investigation after a former colleague falls to his death at a construction site. Harvey recruits Mary Beth (Tyne Daly) to help him investigate what he believes to be a murder.

programme.desc: Harvey (John Karlen) disagrees with the outcome of an investigation after a former colleague falls to his death at a construction site. Harvey recruits Mary Beth (Tyne Daly) to help him investigate what he believes to be a murder.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Hotline
programme.desc: After three women are found strangled, Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate whether or not there is a connection between the attacks and an erotic hotline. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Hotline
programme.desc: After three women are found strangled, Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate whether or not there is a connection between the attacks and an erotic hotline. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are assigned by Internal Affairs to check out a security leak among the 14th Precinct's personnel, forcing the duo to reluctantly spy on their colleagues. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Internal Affairs

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Mr. Lonelyhearts
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are called in when an elderly man comes looking for his wife. But a simple missing persons case soon turns into a major bigamy and fraud case. All the while Cagney deals with a suitor.

programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) team together with another detective, Charles Stephens (guest star Christopher Allport), to investigate an illegal handgun operation. However, their investigation is impeded by Charles's suspension.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo und wer bist Du? II (1)
Submarine Jim (9)
programme.desc: Irgendwo im Nirgendwo bohren Jim und Bianca Löcher in den U-Boot-Boden, um Minigolf zu spielen - mit der Folge, dass das ganze Wasser abläuft! Nun sollen sämtliche Flossenflitzer und der Rest der Crew ihre Flossen in die Löcher stecken, um das Schlimmste zu verhindern, doch das klappt natürlich nicht. Käpt'n Jim braucht eine geniale Idee - und wer wäre da besser geeignet als Bianca, die offizielle "Menschen-Expertin" an Bord? Ihr Plan: Sie brauchen dringend Zwiebeln, die die Flossenflitzer zum Weinen bringen sollen, denn Menschen weinen ja immer, wenn sie Zwiebeln schneiden. So startet "Mission Tränenzwiebel". Doch im Zwiebelgarten treffen Jim und Bianca auf ein neugieriges kleines Mädchen. Jim fürchtet sich zunächst, merkt dann aber schnell, dass Menschen gar nicht so furchteinflößend sind, wie Bianca behauptet hat. Und Bianca selbst scheint nicht die allwissende Expertin zu sein, für die sie sich hält. Am Ende spielen die Zwiebeln keine allzu große Rolle mehr - und allen wird klar, dass manchmal Freudentränen die beste Rettungsmission von allen sind.

programme.title: Submarine Jim (10)
programme.desc: Jims Portrait-Panik. Serie Frankreich (2024). Käpt'n Jim möchte ein Portrait wie das seines Vaters, das seine Wichtigkeit zeigt, und probiert verschiedene Rollen aus, die ihn in turbulente Abenteuer stürzen. Zwischen Streitereien, magischen Zaubersprüchen und wilden Partys wird ihm klar, dass ein Käpt'n mehr ist als ein Bild an der Wand. Schließlich entscheidet er sich für ein Portrait, das die gesamte Crew vereint und seine wahre Bedeutung widerspiegelt. Darsteller: Heiko Obermöller, Fabienne Hesse, Esther Brandt, Kirstin Hesse, Amira Leisner, David M Schulze, Julian Horeyseck, Michaela Kametz, Josef Tratnik, Martin Bross, Sarah Liu, Christiane Werk, Josef Tratnik, David M Schulze, Robert Steudtner, Michaela Kametz, Dirk Hardegen, Josef Tratnik. programme.title: Scooby-Doo und wer bist Du? II (2)
Submarine Jim (11)
programme.desc: Eigentlich will die Crew nur losfahren - doch plötzlich bewegt sich das U-Boot keinen Zentimeter mehr. Ein mysteriöser Metallklotz blockiert das Rad. Während Jim und Yannick noch rätseln, ist Bianca sich sicher: Orca World hat sie gefunden! Die Meeresbiologen sind ihr auf der Spur, um sie zurück ins Becken zu holen, damit sie wieder durch Reifen springt! Jim zögert keine Sekunde. Wenn jemand gejagt wird, dann alle gemeinsam. Er erklärt die Crew offiziell für "untergetaucht" und ordnet Tarnung, falsche Namen und totale Geheimhaltung an. Das ganze U-Boot geht undercover - mit wechselnden Identitäten, chaotischer Tarnfarbe und jeder Menge Verwirrung. Doch das zerrt alles an den Nerven. Namen gehen verloren, Brotdosen ebenfalls, und Siggi rechnet exakt vor, wie viele Meerestiere gerade für einen Orca fliehen. Als alles stillsteht und die Tarnfarbe abgeht, scheint Biancas schlimmste Angst wahr zu werden. Jim übernimmt die Verantwortung und stellt sich - nur um festzustellen, dass diesmal keine Orca-Jäger, sondern eine ordnungsliebende Polizistin dahintersteckt. Am Ende lernt die Crew: Zusammenhalt ist stärker als Angst - und manchmal bedeutet "unter dem Radar" einfach nur. falsch geparkt.

programme.title: Submarine Jim (12)
programme.desc: Die U-boot-Schule. Serie Frankreich (2024). Siggi richtet im U-Boot ein Klassenzimmer ein und unterrichtet Sardinen, Bonnie, Bianca, Yannick und Käpt'n Jim über die Geheimnisse der Menschen. Jim ist diesmal Schüler statt Chef und zeigt wenig Interesse am Lernen. Stattdessen spielt er Papier-Pingpong mit Bianca und entdeckt den Spaß an der Schule. Als eine Prüfung bevorsteht, merkt er jedoch, dass sein Wissen über Menschen begrenzt ist. Ob er die Herausforderung meistert?. Darsteller: Heiko Obermöller, Fabienne Hesse, Esther Brandt, Kirstin Hesse, Amira Leisner, David M Schulze, Julian Horeyseck, Michaela Kametz, Josef Tratnik, Martin Bross, Sarah Liu, Christiane Werk, Josef Tratnik, David M Schulze, Robert Steudtner, Michaela Kametz, Dirk Hardegen, Josef Tratnik. Regie Frédéric Martin

programme.title: Scooby-Doo und wer bist Du? II (3)
Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E01 "Je první den nového školního roku a táta má za úkol dopravit děti včas do školy. Jenže zaspal a teď nemůže Gumballa, Darwina ani Anais nikde najít. Vydá se proto zpět po vlastních stopách, aby zjistil, co předchozího dne dělal a kde by mohli být."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E02 "Gumball s Darwinem zjistí, že Rob, který jim kdysi přísahal pomstu, se je už nějakou dobu snaží odrovnat… jenže jeho pasti nikdy nefungují. Slitují se nad ním a vytyčí si za cíl pomoct mu stát se perfektním úhlavním nepřítelem. Ale odvedou práci až moc dobře a stvoří superpadoucha, který by se mohl vymknout jejich kontrole…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E03 "Gumball s Darwinem usoudí, že je načase přidat se k někomu do party, a shodnou se, že nejdrsnější gang v celém Elmoru jsou důchodci. Dělají, co můžou, aby mezi ně zapadli, a neváhají zajít do krajnosti, jen aby jim (pomalu a šouravě) nadběhli."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E06 "Typická stresující rodinná večeře u Wattersonových dotlačí mámu až na pokraj duševních sil, a tak Nicole začne vzpomínat, jak se seznámila s Richardem. Mohl být její život lepší, kdyby se tehdy vůbec nepustila do hovoru se svým budoucím manželem, a místo toho se vydala jinou cestou?"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E07 "Gumball se dozví, že Wattersonovi už celé roky kradou wi-fi pana Robinsona. Když jednou wi-fi přestane fungovat, pokusí se žít bez ní. Ale život bez internetu se ukáže jako příliš těžký. Gumball s Darwinem se proto rozhodnou, že se prohackují kyberprostorem a zjistí Robinsonovo heslo."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E08 "Gumballa naštve, když mu v internetovém testu opakovaně vyjde, že je typ postavy zvaný ""Trapák"". Je přesvědčený, že se téhle nálepky zbaví jedině tak, že bude dělat přesný opak všeho, co dělá normálně. Jenže když Gumball potlačí svoje přirozené pudy, zanechá po sobě vakuum - díru ve tvaru Gumballa, kterou někdo musí zaplnit. A ten někdo je Tobias, který seriál začne proměňovat v otřepaný sitcom."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E09 "Náhodné setkání se ženou jeho snů přiměje Rockyho, aby přestal žít na internetu a začal hledat lásku pomocí nejnovější seznamovací aplikace. Gumball s Darwinem se Rockymu snaží pomoct proklestit si cestu ošidným světem vztahů přes internet. Při honbě za Rockyho vysněnou dívkou navíc zjistí, že když lidem řeknete, že jednáte ve jménu lásky, odpustí vám téměř cokoli."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E10 "Gumball s Darwinem dají Bobertovi vlastní pokyny, protože chtějí zajistit, aby se choval bezpečně a zodpovědně. Když Bobert začne na jejich pravidla aplikovat svoji robotickou logiku, rychle jim dojde, že se budou muset vyjadřovat mnohem jasněji. Jinak je nakonec všechny zničí…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E11 "Nicole se marně snaží skrýt zklamání, když Richard s dětmi zapomenou na její významný den. Richard musí přijít na to, na jaký významný den zapomněl, a dnešek učinit nezapomenutelným dnem, jinak bude zle!"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E40 "Elmorské zprávy na Kanálu 6 vysílají ty nejžhavější místní příběhy od policejní honičky až po exkluzivní zprávu o Oslici Daisy. Zkušený hlasatel Kip Schlezinger je právě tím, kdo přináší nejnovější zprávy, také ze sportu a o počasí, i když není vůbec o čem referovat…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E09 Gumball svou špatnou náladou nakazí Darwina, který se přidává k jeho remcání. Mrzoutů si všimnou dobří obyvatelé Elmoru, kteří si Gumballa s Darwinem spletou s malými žebráky a uspořádají pro ně dobročinnou sbírku. Jak Gumball s Darwinem vysvětlí tohle nedorozumění, aniž by strhli vlnu nevole?/Wattersonovi si navzájem vyprávějí strašidelné příběhy na rodinné dovolené, když se jejich auto porouchá v poušti. Nezbývá jim, než důvěřovat úplně cizímu člověku, který vypadá jako děsivý muž z mámina smyšleného příběhu. Když je přivede k opuštěné čerpací stanici, Wattersonovi uvěří vlastnímu děsivým představám.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E11 Podvodník: Když Gumball s Darwinem odhalí, že diplom ředitele Browna je falešný, ředitel to hodlá za každou cenu udržet to v tajnosti. Snaží se je všemožně podplatit, aby mlčeli, ale jim ve skutečnosti na pravosti diplomu nezáleží. Ředitel si jejich nezájem vyloží jako tvrdé vyjednávání a nezastaví se ani před zoufalými činy. Díra: Gumball s Darwinem si ve škole všímají podivných nesrovnalostí a nakonec jim dojde, že mívali spolužačku Molly, která zmizela a nyní si na ni nikdo nevzpomíná. Pan Small potvrdí jejich podezření a bere je na návštěvu do jiné dimenze, kam svět odklízí své omyly.

programme.desc: S03E18 HESLO: Když Gumball a Darwin zjistí, že je Anais tátovo nejoblíbenější dítě, udělají všechno, aby ji o tuto pozici připravili.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E19 PROKRASTINÁTOŘI: Gumball s Darwinem mají za úkol vynést odpadky do pěti hodin a hledají všechny myslitelné způsoby prokrastinace. SKOŘÁPKA: Gumball nechtěně rozbije Pennyinu skořápku a spatří její skutečné já. Zbývá přesvědčit Penny že její pravé já je úžasné.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E06 Antonovo toustové tělíčko se rozpustí na hodině plavání. Když ho Gumball s Darwinem druhý den potkají živého a zdravého, rozhodnou se odhalit jeho tajemství. Ukáže se, že v případě potřeby si jeho rodiče podle speciálního receptu vždy upečou nového Antona. Kluci to vyzkouší doma a vytvoří celou armádu klonů, jejichž vůdce - Antuan, chce zničit Antona a ovládnout svět. / Děti žadoní, aby jim táta pořídil štěně, jenže ten je zaskočí, a přinese domů želvu. Ačkoli se ukáže, že je nesmírně agresivní, obzvlášť vůči Gumballovi, snaží se jí rodina poskytnout láskyplný domov. Jenže bezvýsledně. Zlá želva uteče a začne řádit. Wattersonovi ji musejí najít dřív, než zničí Elmore.

programme.desc: S02E23 Wattersonovi jsou normální rodinka. Táta je růžový králík a stará se o děti, zatímco máma pracuje v továrně na duhu. Nejstarší z dětí je Gumball, modrý kocour, pak je tu geniální čtyřletá králičí holčička Anais a nakonec Darwin, zlatá rybka, které narostly nohy. Hlavním hrdinou příběhů je Gumball, který se potýká se stejnými problémy a výzvami jako ostatní dvanáctiletí kluci - třeba když musí prchat před útočícím Tyrannosaurem Rexem nebo spát pod mostem, protože mu robot ukradne totožnost, nebo se má převléknout za roztleskávačku a dělat roznožky, aby udělal dojem na dívku svých snů. Vítejte v Gumballově úžasném světě, ve kterém je všechno normální tak trochu divné.

Aby dokázal, že je pro Ocha dostatečně blízkým kamarádem a mohl se seznámit s jeho rodinou, musí podstoupit Ochovu náročnou zkoušku přátelství."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět

Richard odchází s penězi a vůbec mu nedochází, že právě spáchal bankovní loupež. Nicole s dětmi mu brzy vysvětlí, co provedl, a snaží se najít způsob, jak se vyhnout policejnímu stíhání a peníze vrátit."

programme.title: Totální Dramarama

programme.title: Totální Dramarama

programme.title: Totální Dramarama
programme.desc: S03E21 Gwen si do školky objedná balíček s blasterem, který dokáže změnit povahu člověka. Než ho namíří na své rodiče, kteří jsou správní mileniálové, rozhodne se ho vyzkoušet na svých spolužácích ze školky.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E35 "Když Lesliemu začnou opadávat okvětní lístky, má pocit, že jeho krása uvadá. Gumball s Darwinem využijí veškerých svých znalostí o stylu a kráse, aby mu pomohli. Jediný problém je v tom, že o stylu a kráse nevědí vůbec nic. Jejich metody jsou stále extrémnější a Leslie začíná pochybovat o tom, jestli chce pro krásu obětovat všechno."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E37 "Když Wattersonovi dostanou předvolání, aby se dostavili na radnici, obávají se nejhoršího. O to více jsou příjemně překvapeni, když jim starosta nabídne nový dům. Má to ale háček: dům stojí v jiném státě! Starosta Elmoru došel k závěru, že Wattersonovi snižují cenu nemovitostí v celém městě. Pokud chtějí v Elmoru zůstat musí rodina dokázat, že patří mezi spořádané spoluobčany."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E32 "Ať se Gumball snaží sebevíc, Carmen má za každých okolností se svým názorem navrch. Gumball se snaží získat morální převahu, ale při tom zoufale selže. Rozhodne se, že vylepšení sebe sama není jeho styl. Zbývá mu jediná možnost, dostat Carmen na jeho úroveň."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E33 "Každý člen rodiny si myslí, že to má nejhorší. Gumball a Darwin si myslí, že nejhorší to mají kluci. Máma si myslí, že ženy. Anais si myslí, že děti a táta si myslí, že dospěláci. Dojdou k závěru, že rozhodnout jejich při může jedině to, že každý stráví den v kůži někoho jiného, bez ohledu na to, jestli je moc malý, moc velký nebo nosí podpatky."
